Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, c As Range, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "Sheet1"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("C2").Formula = "=$A$1*2"
        ws.Range("C3").Formula = "=A$1+1"
        ws.Range("C4").Formula = "=B1+A1"
        ws.Range("C1:C4").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1:C4")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 1
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("C2").Formula = "=$A$1*2"
        ws.Range("C3").Formula = "=A$1+1"
        ws.Range("C1:C3").ApplyNames IgnoreRelativeAbsolute:=False
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1:C3")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 2
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Tax", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$2"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=A1*A2"
        ws.Range("C2").Formula = "=A2-A1"
        ws.Range("C1:C2").ApplyNames Names:="Tax"
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1:C2")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 3
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Tax", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$2"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=A1*A2"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames Names:=Array("Rate", "Tax")
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 4
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Data", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1:$A$5"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A5)"
        ws.Range("C2").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A4)"
        ws.Range("C3").Formula = "=SUM($A$1:$A$5)"
        ws.Range("C1:C3").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1:C3")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 5
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("D1").Formula = "=A1*3"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1:D1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 6
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=Sheet1!A1*2"
        ws.Range("C2").Formula = "=""A1""&A1"
        ws.Range("C1:C2").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1:C2")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 7
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames Names:="NoSuch"
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 8
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 9
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "5"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 10
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate2", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 11
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Jan", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$B$1:$B$4"
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Sales", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$2:$C$2"
        ws.Range("E1").Formula = "=B2*2"
        ws.Range("E1").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("E1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 12
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Jan", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$B$1:$B$4"
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Sales", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$2:$C$2"
        ws.Range("E1").Formula = "=B2*2"
        ws.Range("E1").ApplyNames UseRowColumnNames:=False
        For Each c In ws.Range("E1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 13
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames Order:=xlColumnThenRow
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 14
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=SUM(A1,A1)"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 15
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=A1:A1"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 16
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        ws.Range("C1").FormulaArray = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 17
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames AppendLast:=True
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 18
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Low", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$1"
        wb.Names.Add Name:="low2", RefersTo:="=Sheet1!$A$2"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=A1+A2"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    Case 19
        wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=0.5"
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=0.5*2"
        ws.Range("C1").ApplyNames
        For Each c In ws.Range("C1")
            s = s & "|" & c.Formula
        Next
        Tried = Mid(s, 2)
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function

Public Function Spelling() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, s As String, c As Range
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    wb.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=" & ws.Name & "!$A$1"
    wb.Names.Add Name:="sumx", RefersTo:="=1"
    ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=Rate*2"
    ws.Range("C2").Formula = "=rate*2"
    ws.Range("C3").Formula = "=RATE*2"
    ws.Range("C4").Formula = "=Sum*2"
    ws.Range("C5").Formula = "=rate(1,2,3)"
    ws.Range("C6").Formula = "=SUMX+1"
    ws.Range("C7").Formula = "=Abs*2"
    For Each c In ws.Range("C1:C7")
        s = s & "|" & c.Formula
    Next
    wb.Close False
    Spelling = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
